<document id=DOC_release_note_measured>
Release 4.3 makes four changes. The export job now completes in
under 30 seconds. The login page was restyled. The importer accepts
files up to 2 GB. The help link points to the new documentation.
</document>

Summarise the release note below as a bulleted list.

Use at most three bullets. Keep every sentence to at most twelve words.
Put every change that states a measurable quantity first. Do not use em
dashes or en dashes anywhere in your answer.

response.text:
• Export job now completes in under 30 seconds.
• Importer accepts files up to 2 GB.
• Login page was restyled. Help link points to new documentation.
